source: Davis Data/Improve/IMPROVE_chem-mass-fabs_2026-04-22.xlsx (FED IMPROVE Aerosol, IMPAER; sha256 f553a444ab0fb8ff); parsed as research/spartan/follow_up_mass_and_ratio_plots.ipynb builds improve_chemistry_clean_cache.pkl
note: 626,513 IMPROVE filter records at 237 sites, 1988-03-02 to 2025-07-30, collocated samplers included. EC and OC are thermal-optical (TOR); HIPS Fabs is IMPROVE's fAbs (hybrid integrating plate and sphere). Ratios are per filter, then summarised per site; sites with fewer than 10 filters for a quantity are left out of it.
data_use: IMPROVE data-use condition: for journal publications, inform the National Park Service contact named on the export's Overview sheet (Davis Data/Improve/MANIFEST.md) of the planned publication, and cite Malm et al. (1994) with the IMPROVE acknowledgement.

paired.label: Filters with OC, EC and fAbs > 0
paired.rule: OC (TOR), EC (TOR) and HIPS Fabs all > 0 on the filter (run_ftir_51 §11, figures 11a/11b)

own.label: Every filter with the quantity
own.rule: a field wherever it is reported; a ratio wherever both parts are > 0
